title: blob-client: jmap-blob-client bindings
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B12. Crates: jmap-blob-client. Size: M.

Implement crate-jmap-blob-client per docs/design/blobext.md §8 (blobext-03 §2.1, §4-§8), mirroring jmap-mail-client: sealed JmapBlobExt::with_blob_session, blob_account_id from primaryAccounts[blob2], for_account, blob_capability; blob_set/blob_create/blob_touch/blob_destroy; blob_get with BlobGetInput; blob_lookup adding each type's capability from jmap_types::data_types (decision 14) to using, rejecting names whose capability the Session lacks and empty inputs with InvalidArgument; blob_convert; upload_url (account uploadUrl else session); preferred_digest_algorithm, lookup_type_names, verify_digest. using = core + blob2 (+ type capabilities), never urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob. No conditional parameter (decision 8: base-client SetCall). Acceptance: wiremock tests where request bodies equal the -03 §9 requests and responses parse §9 (absent and null oldState/newState/expires); lookup adds mail for Email; public-api snapshot.
